 MAHARASHTRA.

 ORDER

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF KARNATAKA, DHARWAD BENCH
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Prashant S. Kadadevar
, learned cou nsel for the petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.
Perused the records.

2. The pres ent petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. with the following prayer :-
"WHEREFORE, the petitioner most humbly prays that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow the petition and grant Anticipatory Bail to the peti tioner wh o is Accused No.1 in Karwar Town P S Crime No.22/2020 for offence punishable 406,
420 R/w 34 of IPC, in the interest of justice.

"
3. The brief facts of the case are as under :-
A complaint ca me to be lodged by Wil son Antony Menezes with Karwar Town Police on 19. 03.2020 w hich was registered in Crime No.22/2020 for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 read with Section 34 of IPC.

4. Gist of the complaint averments reveal that a Co-Operative Society wa s inaugurated in the name and style of Samruddh Jeevana Multi S tate Multi Purpose Co-Op Society Ltd in Datta Complex,
Green Str eet, Karwar.

entities.text: Samruddh Jeevana Multi S tate Multi Purpose Co-Op Society Ltd
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The money was collected from the general pu blic with a promise that th e money would b e doubled and as s uch, complainant also believed the said assurance a nd invested sum of Rs.1,25,400/- and so also other general public have invested to the tune of Rs.50 crores and none of them are repaid the money as assured and therefore sou ght for action.
5. Police have registered a case a gainst the petitioner and others for the a foresaid offence and are investigating the matter.

In the meantime, the petitioner approached the District Court for grant of anticipatory bail in November - 2022 which was rejected by learned Principal Distric t and Sessions Judge, Uttara Kannada, Karwad by order dated 28. 11.2022 in Criminal Miscellaneous No.466/ 2022.

entities.text: Principal Distric t and Sessions Judge, Uttara Kannada, Karwad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.

Sri. Mahesh S/O. Kishan Motewar vs The State Of Karnataka on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190300882/
2 6.

Reiterating the grounds urged in the petition, Shri. Prashant S. Kadadevar, learned cou nsel for the petitioner v ehemently contended that the petitioner h as resigned from the dir ector ship of the said society by sending a resigna tion letter on 10. 10.2013 which was accep ted by the society by resolution dated 18.10.2013 and therefore he has got nothing to do with the delinks of the society and sou ght for grant of anticipatory bail.

7. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respond ent however opposes the bail request by contending that the petitioner has gone on cheating public at large by forming the aforesaid society and other directors are none other than his own family members and not only in Karnataka but in other parts of the country as well, petitioner has cheated and therefore he is not entitled for grant of bail.
8. She als o empha sized that the petitioner is not available to the Investigating Agency from the date of registration of the c ase and therefore, sou ght for rejection of the bail.
9. In view of rival contentions of the parties, this Court perused the material on record meticulously.

10. Admi ttedly, material on record would go to show that the petitioner ha s resigned from the directorship of the society in October 2013 which was accepted by the society by resolution dated 18. 10.2023.
A complaint came to be lodged in the year 2020.
11. Whether at all, the petitioner continued to collect the money in the name of society or not cannot be decided by this Court at this stage.

The allegation s leveled against the petitioner is serious and learned High Court Government Pleader has made a categorical statement that the petitioner has collected the money acr os s the c ountry in the name of the society is a matter that cannot b e lost sight of.
The truth ab out the allegations can be unearthed only after the petitioner is taken into custody and undergo limited period of custodial interrogation.
At the sa me time, since the p etitioner has already resigned from the society, his interest is also protected.

12. Directing the peti tioner to join investigation on particular date and underg o limited period of custodial interrogation would result in harmonizing the right of the petitioner and need of the prosecution.
13. Accordingly, the following order is passed:
ORDE R

The criminal petition is allowed subject to the following conditions:
1. The Petitioner is directed to join the investigation by appearing before the Investigation Officer on 28.06.2023 at 10.00 a.m.
2.

The Investigation Officer is at liberty to take the petitioner to custody and c omplete the cus todial investigation if any, on the sa me day before 6.00 p.m. and Sri. Mahesh S/O. Kishan Motewar vs The State Of Karnataka on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190300882/
3 thereafter enlarge the petitioner on bail by taking a bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees one lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum.
3.
The petitioner shall not tamper the pr osecution witn esses in any manner.
4. The petition er shall attend the Court regularly and appear before the Investigation agency as and wh en directed.

5. The petitioner shall mark his attendance before the Inv estigating Officer on every third Sunday between 10.00 am and 2.00 pm., till the final report is filed or for a period of six months whichev er is earlier.
6.
The petitioner shall not directly or indirectly tamper the prosecution evidence or hamper the investigation process in any manner.
7. The p etitioner shall not leave the jurisdi ction of Haveri District wi thout prior permission.

Violation of any one of the conditions would entitle the prosecuti on to seek for cancella tion of the bail.
Ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
